query:
EVALUATE
ROW ( "All years", [Total Emissions (tCO2e)],
      "2025", CALCULATE ( [Total Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2025 ) )
EVALUATE ROW ( "All", [Emission Rows], "2023", CALCULATE ( [Emission Rows], dim_date[year] = 2023 ) )

EVALUATE ROW ( "2023", CALCULATE ( [Sites Reporting], dim_date[year] = 2023 ),
               "2025", CALCULATE ( [Sites Reporting], dim_date[year] = 2025 ) )

EVALUATE
ROW ( "Scope 1", CALCULATE ( [Scope 1 Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2025 ),
      "Scope 2", CALCULATE ( [Scope 2 Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2025 ),
      "Scope 3", CALCULATE ( [Scope 3 Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2025 ) )

EVALUATE
ROW ( "Scope 1 measure, slicer on scope 2",
      CALCULATE ( [Scope 1 Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_source[scope] = 2 ) )
EVALUATE ROW ( "plain filter", CALCULATE ( CALCULATE ( [Total Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_source[scope] = 1 ), dim_source[scope] = 2 ) )

EVALUATE
ROW ( "Tallinn 2025", CALCULATE ( [Emissions per Million EUR (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2025, dim_site[site_id] = "EE01" ),
      "Head office", CALCULATE ( [Emissions per Million EUR (tCO2e)], dim_site[site_id] = "FI02" ) )

EVALUATE
ROW ( "Average FTE 2024", CALCULATE ( [Average FTE], dim_date[year] = 2024 ),
      "Wrong: FTE summed over 2024", CALCULATE ( SUM ( fact_site_metrics[fte] ), dim_date[year] = 2024 ) )
EVALUATE ROW ( "Per FTE 2024", CALCULATE ( [Emissions per FTE (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2024 ) )

EVALUATE
ROW ( "Stored", [Total Emissions (tCO2e)],
      "Recalculated", [Recalculated Emissions (tCO2e)],
      "Difference", [Reconciliation Difference (tCO2e)],
      "Unrounded", [Total Emissions (tCO2e)] - [Recalculated Emissions (tCO2e)] )

EVALUATE
ROW ( "Prior year of 2025", CALCULATE ( [Emissions Prior Year (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2025 ),
      "2024 directly", CALCULATE ( [Total Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2024 ),
      "Prior year of 2023", CALCULATE ( [Emissions Prior Year (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2023 ) )

EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE (
    FILTER (
        CROSSJOIN ( VALUES ( dim_site[site_id] ), VALUES ( dim_date[date_key] ) ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( CALCULATE ( [Total Emissions (tCO2e)] ) )
            && NOT ISBLANK ( CALCULATE ( [Emissions Prior Year (tCO2e)] ) )
    ),
    dim_date[year] = 2025, dim_site[site_id] = "EE02"
)

EVALUATE
ROW ( "Like-for-like 2025", CALCULATE ( [Emissions Change vs Prior Year (%)], dim_date[year] = 2025 ),
      "Naive 2025", DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Total Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2025 ),
                             CALCULATE ( [Total Emissions (tCO2e)], dim_date[year] = 2024 ) ) - 1,
      "Tartu like-for-like", CALCULATE ( [Emissions Change vs Prior Year (%)], dim_date[year] = 2025, dim_site[site_id] = "EE02" ) )
